# Changelog

This is the **first official LiftEngine Unity SDK**. Release history starts here.

## [1.1.7] - 2026-08-19 — First official LiftEngine SDK

First official public release.

- Unity package for AppLovin MAX (`com.liftengine.sdk`)
- Integration Manager (**Window → LiftEngine**)
- Example `LiftEngineSettings` asset (copy to `Assets/Resources/LiftEngineSettings.asset`)
- Integration guide and AI wiring prompt
